name: Workshop Null  Erebus Oneiric Engine MkIV
description:
The Erebus Oneiric Engine MkIV is the fourth and most sophisticated iteration of Workshop Null's dream architecture platform, produced by the anonymous collective of neurosurgeons, engineers, and lucid-dreaming theorists known only as 'Null' from an undisclosed atelier location believed to be somewhere in the sub-level districts of GLMZ's Sector 7 industrial ring. Fewer than thirty complete MkIV units are estimated to exist, each individually fabricated and tuned to its recipient's unique neural oscillation signature over a minimum eight-week pre-installation assessment period. The core architecture consists of a hexagonal array of neuromorphic processing nodes implanted along the hippocampal-entorhinal circuit and the default mode network, operating collectively as a real-time dream environment synthesizer capable of generating fully immersive, architecturally coherent dreamscapes with physics-engine fidelity. The system interfaces with REM and NREM sleep stages through dedicated delta and theta wave co-processors, allowing the user to exert conscious architectural control over dream environments — constructing, modifying, and populating spaces with a reported granularity equivalent to a master architect working in physical reality. The MkIV introduces Workshop Null's experimental 'Resonance Bridge' subsystem, which enables two or more Erebus carriers to enter shared dream spaces through a short-range encrypted theta-wave handshake, creating a collaborative unconscious workspace that persists across sleep sessions and can be used for communication, creative collaboration, or — controversially — interrogation. Full sensory fidelity within dream architectures reaches subjective equivalence with waking perception across all six sensory modalities, including proprioception and interoception.

The Erebus Oneiric Engine exists at the intersection of art, therapy, and the deeply transgressive, and its cultural footprint is disproportionately large for such a small production run. Among GLMZ's artistic elite, owning an Erebus is considered the ultimate creative credential — several of the city's most celebrated architects, composers, and narrative designers attribute their most acclaimed works entirely to designs developed within Erebus dreamscapes. The shared-dream capability has given rise to a clandestine practice called 'Null Sessions,' private gatherings where two to four Erebus holders enter collaborative unconscious space together, creating shared experiential architectures that exist nowhere in the physical world. These sessions have been described by participants as the most profound experiences of their lives and have also reportedly produced at least three cases of individuals who became so attached to their shared dream architectures that they developed clinical resistance to waking life. Workshop Null maintains no public communications channel; new commissions are accepted only through a referral system known only to existing clients.
tier_availability: Tier 5 — commission-only; new clients accepted by referral exclusively; waiting list estimated at 18-36 months
legality: Prohibited — the Erebus is not submitted for regulatory review and carries no licensing pathway; possession constitutes a Class-C Neural Contraband violation under Meridian Cognitive Safety Ordinance 7.4; enforcement is inconsistent due to the implant's popularity among influential cultural figures
installation_requirements: 8-week pre-installation neural oscillation profiling (conducted covertly by Workshop Null representatives); installation performed in a private surgical suite by Workshop Null's anonymous surgical team; procedure duration 18-22 hours; 2-week post-operative sleep monitoring in a Null-supervised facility; recipient must undergo 4 weeks of guided lucid dreaming calibration before full activation
rejection_risk: Moderate — the individualized tuning process reduces rejection incidence to approximately 11%, but incompatibility events are severe; 'Oneiric Cascade' events (uncontrolled dream bleed into waking consciousness) occur in approximately 4% of recipients and require immediate explantation
maintenance: Workshop Null provides ongoing maintenance through encrypted remote diagnostics and in-person calibration sessions scheduled annually; recipients are given a physical contact protocol for emergency support; no third-party maintenance is possible without voiding the implant's stability architecture, which can result in catastrophic dream-bleed

side_effects: Oneiric Bleed (4% incidence): involuntary intrusion of dream architecture elements into waking perception, ranging from mild visual overlays to complete waking hallucination of dream environments; requires emergency explantation in severe cases

Somnophilic Attachment Disorder: prolonged use of high-fidelity dream environments produces measurable preference for dream-state over waking life in approximately 22% of long-term users, with clinical cases involving deliberate sleep extension and resistance to waking

Resonance Contamination: after multiple Null Sessions with the same partners, recipients report persistent intrusion of the other participants' emotional states, memories, and aesthetic preferences into their own waking cognition

Architectural Imprinting: users who spend significant time constructing complex dream environments report the spaces beginning to feel more real and emotionally significant than physical locations, occasionally leading to grief responses when dream architectures are lost to implant resets
cultural_context: Workshop Null occupies a mythologized position in GLMZ's underground creative culture — the anonymous collective is spoken of with a reverence typically reserved for legendary artists, and the identity of its members has been the subject of obsessive speculation for over a decade without resolution. The Erebus Oneiric Engine is simultaneously the most coveted and most feared implant in the luxury BCI market: coveted for the creative and experiential possibilities it unlocks, feared for its documented capacity to make waking life feel insufficient by comparison. The 'Null Sessions' shared dream gatherings have been documented by underground journalists as everything from transcendent collaborative art experiences to something closer to a shared addiction, with at least one well-documented case of a four-person Null Session group that collectively refused to disengage from a shared dreamscape for eleven days before medical intervention.
known_users: Renowned architect Sable Orin-Vasquez, designer of the GLMZ Canopy District (credits Erebus dreamscapes for all major works post-2194)
Composer collective 'The Null Quartet' — four musicians who compose exclusively through shared Resonance Bridge sessions
Unknown — Workshop Null's client list is sealed; at least one sitting corporate board member is rumored to be a recipient based on circumstantial behavioral evidence
story_hooks: A Null Session participant has gone missing — physically present in their residence but completely unresponsive, their Erebus cycling through an apparent infinite dream loop. The other three members of their session group are experiencing intrusive fragments of what appears to be the missing person's dream architecture bleeding into their waking perception, and the fragments contain what looks like evidence of a crime.

Workshop Null has broken its silence to reach out to a specific individual — not a wealthy patron or celebrated artist, but an unremarkable person from Sector 7's lower districts. The referral came from an existing client who claims they encountered this person in a shared dream despite never having met them physically, suggesting the individual may be naturally generating theta-wave patterns compatible with the Resonance Bridge without an implant.

A counterfeit Erebus MkIV has appeared on the black market — superficially convincing but lacking the individualized oscillation tuning. Recipients of the counterfeit are experiencing severe Oneiric Cascade events, and Workshop Null has quietly made it known that they want the fabricators identified, with the implication that their interest extends beyond intellectual property.
